review_description: Mark was very professional and made the whole process from quote to installation very simple and straightforward.  He contacted Synergy for us and even set the app up on my phone. I would highly recommend Mark and his team at Belenus for your Solar panels and any general electrical work.

Mark from Belenus made initial contact and spoke to me about what I wanted. He then arranged to come out and discussed the options available and actually listened to me unlike some other companies. He provided quotes based on what products I wanted aswell as some other recommendations. I ended up going with one of his recommendations. Once I gave the go ahead the installation was fast and the installers turned up on time and did the job without issue. Also the installers are employees instead of sub contractors so everyone was on the same page from the get go. Mark also organised all the tariff feed in and meter applications.

Sales quote was excellent, salesman visited site and inspected location to provide a firm quotation.Installers were 1st class, no fuss, and quality installation.Enphase system chosen is great to be able to fully monitor all PV cells and their production, monitoring and reporting system output is easy, very happy.

Belenus has been an absolute pleasure to deal with.Mark provided awesome advice and walked me through the whole process while their installation team were friendly, polite and professional.The products they installed for me where of a high quality and they provided exceptional service throughout the whole processBelenus provide a 25 year workmanship warranty and they mean it! They have continued to provide support and still advise me on my Solar Analytics platform well after the completion of the installation and final paymentI could not recommend a solar company any higher, I will be referring them to all my family and friends in the future.Thanks Belenus!

Working with Belenus to install my solar power system was a great experience. From the initial quotation to the installation and after service care, the team are always polite, respectful and informative. They really know their stuff when it comes to renewable energy. They've also installed some lights and arranged/install a black powerpoint on my kitchen island bench.
